description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'exclude_patterns' functionality in Git's reference store. It sets up various test scenarios to verify the correct behavior of referencing and exclusion mechanisms within Git, including creating, excluding, and verifying references.

methods.name: for_each_ref__exclude
methods.description: Runs 'git for-each-ref' with exclusion patterns and captures the output.

methods.name: assert_jumps
methods.description: Checks the trace logs to verify the number of boundary jumps based on reference format.

methods.name: assert_no_jumps
methods.description: Ensures that no jumps are present in the trace logs.
